universal.label: Numéro d'Urgence Européen (Unified EU Emergency)
universal.description: Universal emergency number across France and the European Union, operating alongside France's specialized 15 (SAMU), 17 (Police), and 18 (Pompiers) lines.

categories.name: Police & Gendarmerie
categories.description: 17 Police Secours for immediate law enforcement and public safety.

numbers.label: Police Secours / Gendarmerie
numbers.audience: Anyone witnessing or experiencing violence, theft, assault, or a road accident with injuries.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 17 to reach the nearest Police Nationale or Gendarmerie dispatch center immediately.

categories.name: Medical (SAMU)
categories.description: 15 SAMU emergency medical dispatch, 114 deaf/SMS emergency, and 3114 crisis line.

numbers.label: SAMU (Service d'Aide Médicale Urgente)
numbers.audience: Anyone experiencing a medical emergency, coma, chest pain, hemorrhage, breathing distress, or intoxication.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 15 to speak directly with a regulating emergency doctor (médecin régulateur) or dispatch a SMUR mobile intensive care unit.

numbers.label: Urgence 114 (Deaf, Hard-of-Hearing & Silent SMS/Video)
numbers.audience: Deaf, hard-of-hearing, aphasic individuals, or anyone unable to speak aloud during an emergency.
numbers.whenToUse: Send an SMS or start a video/text relay session at 114 to contact SAMU (15), Police (17), or Pompiers (18).

numbers.label: Numéro National de Prévention du Suicide
numbers.audience: Individuals in psychological distress or suicidal crisis, and their loved ones.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 3114 anytime to speak with a trained psychiatric nurse or psychologist.

categories.name: Fire & Rescue (Pompiers)
categories.description: 18 Sapeurs-Pompiers for fires, road crashes, gas leaks, and casualty rescue.

numbers.label: Sapeurs-Pompiers (Fire & Emergency Rescue)
numbers.audience: Anyone reporting a fire, gas leak, drowning, electrocution, structural risk, or traffic collision.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 18 when physical rescue, firefighting, or rapid first-responder extraction is needed.

numbers.label: CROSS Maritime Search & Rescue
numbers.audience: Swimmers, sailors, and witnesses of emergencies at sea or along the French coast.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 196 for immediate coordination with French maritime rescue centers.

categories.name: Women & Child Safety
categories.description: 3919 Violences Femmes Info and 119 Allô Enfance en Danger.

numbers.label: Violences Femmes Info
numbers.audience: Women victims of domestic, physical, psychological, or sexual violence, and witnesses.
numbers.whenToUse: Call 3919 for anonymous, confidential guidance and shelter support (call 17 or 112 in immediate danger).

numbers.label: Allô Enfance en Danger (Child Protection)
numbers.audience: Children facing abuse or danger, and adults concerned about a minor's safety.
numbers.whenToUse: Dial 119 anytime; calls do not appear on itemised phone bills.

categories.name: Cyber Crime & Fraud
categories.description: Info Escroqueries and Cybermalveillance government assistance.

numbers.label: Info Escroqueries (Ministry of the Interior Cyber Fraud)
numbers.audience: Victims of online scams, phishing, identity theft, or fraudulent payments.
numbers.whenToUse: Call to receive police guidance on filing a THESEE or Pharos cybercrime complaint.
